children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 22, following a slew of corporate developments, block deal and earnings announcements.

Augmont Enterprises share price slipped more than 2 percent amid company's profit fell 15.3% to Rs 57.7 crore Vs Rs 68.2 crore, while revenue jumped 30.2% to Rs 18,945.6 crore Vs Rs 14,552 crore, YoY.
Shares of Pine Labs added nearly 5 percent after 4.97 crore shares (4.3% equity) of the company change hands in block deal.

Share price of Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers added 2 percent after board approved a capital budgetary outlay of Rs 2,896 crore for the construction of a Greenfield Shipyard at Raichak to enhance GRSE's shipbuilding capacity in both the naval and commercial segments.

Pace Digitek share price added 10 percent following company's subsidiary, Lineage Power (LPPL), has secured an order valued at Rs 488.46 crore from NTPC GE Power Services (NGSL) for the BESS project at Barh STPP (NTPC Stages I & II).

Shares of Aequs rose nearly 4% as meeting of the board of directors of the company is scheduled to be held on Friday, September 25, 2026 to consider and evaluate the proposal of preferential issue of warrants convertible into equity shares of the company to the promoter, in one or more tranches, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company and such other statutory, regulatory and/or other approvals as may be required.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Augmont Enterprises falls 2% as Q1 profit declines; Pace Digitek gains 10% on order win
